keys.do.switch: Quick switch: a session, a group or the supervisor
keys.do.close: Close a dialog, the session panel or the search
keys.do.quote: Reply quoting the text selected in an agent’s message
keys.do.mention: Mention a group member: ↑ / ↓, then Enter or Tab
keys.do.edit_todo: Edit the focused to-do: Enter saves, Esc cancels
keys.do.urgent: At the start of a new to-do: urgent
keys.nothing: Nothing found. The search looks at the title, project, branch, ticket and MR.
keys.find: Find a session, a group or the supervisor
keys.find_placeholder: Session, project, branch, ticket or MR…
keys.help.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keys.help.note: While the cursor is in a text field, single keys type letters; {key} always works.
